 has withdrawn from the Netherlands squad, and Ryan Gravenberch (heel fracture) is also out of it. Jeremie Frimpong, Conor Bradley, Hugo Ekitiké and Giovanni Leoni were all unavailable at the club's last update.

VAN DIJK TAKES SQUAD TO THE MUSEUM [...] Bart Verbruggen: Football Insider, a clickbait site, claimed last week that Liverpool are considering a move for the 24-year-old Brighton goalkeeper as a long-term successor to Alisson. There is no new supporting evidence. Credibility: Low.

There have been no significant developments from reliable sources concerning contracts, ownership, investment or senior club staffing.

FIXTURES (UK TIMES)

Sun 22 Nov: Manchester United (h) Premier League 4.30pm (Sky Sports) [...] Víctor Muñoz has won Liverpool's Goal of the Month for October, voted for by supporters, for his equaliser in the 2-1 win at Brentford. Natalia Ramos' long-range strike for the Women's team at Aston Villa came second, and the first goal of Bradley Barcola's hat-trick against LASK was third.

TRANSFERS

There are no confirmed transfer developments this morning, and nothing on Liverpool's plans from the likes of David Ornstein and Paul Joyce.
